summary: Tested Admin Settings, Admin Promotions, Admin Users Management with Growth Progress, and Growth Tracking API for Adverlyx Digital Instagram Growth SaaS. All features are working correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin account and demo data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Settings page at /admin/settings loads correctly with Branding, UI Settings, Features, Content, and Promo Banner tabs. Admin Promotions page at /admin/promotions loads with Overview, ICPs, A/B Tests, and Campaigns tabs. Admin Users Management at /admin/users shows Growth Progress column and enhanced User Details modal with Instagram Stats, Growth Progress section, editable fields, and Quick Actions for plan changes.

admin_settings_page.details: Platform Settings page loads with 5 tabs: Branding, UI Settings, Features, Content, Promo Banner. Branding tab shows Brand Identity, Colors, Gradient Colors sections with live preview.

admin_promotions_page.details: Promotion Planning page loads with 4 tabs: Overview, ICPs, A/B Tests, Campaigns. Shows stats cards for Active ICPs (3/3), Running A/B Tests, Active Campaigns, Templates. Quick Actions available.

admin_users_management.details: User Management page shows table with User, Status, Plan, Instagram, Growth Progress, Actions columns. data-testid='admin-users-management' present.

user_details_modal_view.details: Clicking View opens modal with user info, Instagram Stats (Followers, Following, Posts), Growth Progress (Target, Gained, progress bar), Subscription Details, Quick Actions for plan changes.

user_details_modal_edit.details: Edit button enables editing of Name, Email, Plan (dropdown), Instagram username. Cancel and Save buttons appear. All fields are editable.

quick_actions_plan_change.details: Quick Actions section shows Basic, Pro, Enterprise buttons for plan changes, plus Suspend/Activate button.

growth_tracking_api.details: Returns growth status with user_id, plan_name, target_followers, start_followers, current_followers, followers_gained, progress_percent, is_complete, estimated_completion, daily_gain_rate

admin_settings_api.details: All settings endpoints return correct data

admin_promotions_api.details: All promotions endpoints return correct data

admin_users_api.details: User details include instagram_stats, growth_progress, subscription data

user_dashboard_growth_progress.details: User dashboard shows Monthly Growth Progress section. Plan Growth Progress card only appears when user has active subscription (demo user has no plan so card not shown, which is expected behavior).

notes: The Growth Progress column in the users table shows '-' for users without active subscriptions or without start_followers set. This is expected behavior. The Plan Growth Progress card on user dashboard only appears when subscription.status === 'active', which is correct.
